description: The games the mashup needs. One row per game. supported_builds drives which native hash tables must be filled.

columns.name: Display name
columns.role: primary (host, Melty installs into it and starts it) or companion (runs alongside, Melty passes its folder)
columns.version_range: Melty recipe version range for this game
columns.supported_builds: Exact builds the mod has data for (GTA: native hash tables)
columns.loader: Loader the mashup needs; must be one Melty installs, or none
columns.exe: Process image name the mod checks for
columns.brings: What this game really brings into the mashup

rows.notes: Widen version_range when another build gets a filled hash table (sheet natives, column xmap).
